headlines.title: OpenAI president Greg Brockman says company could be IPO ready in 2027
headlines.excerpt: Speaking at a Wall Street Journal tech conference on Wednesday, the executive touted how the company had been gaining ground in the enterprise market, where rival Anthropic had already successfully made inroads.

headlines.title: The ex-Secret Service agent who flipped a hacker is now raising a second $250M cybersecurity fund
headlines.excerpt: Stephen Ward, a former Secret Service agent and Home Depot CISO, is preparing a second fund of roughly $250 million for Brightmind Partners.

headlines.title: Harbinger raises $240M after expanding into defense
headlines.excerpt: The Los Angeles-based startup has now raised more than $650 million, and is working on electric trucks, emergency vehicles, and a driverless platform for the military.

headlines.title: Food delivery startup Wonder files for IPO as it explores its next big bite
headlines.excerpt: Following years of fundraising, acquisitions, and expansion, food delivery startup Wonder is moving closer to becoming a publicly traded company.

headlines.title: Axiom Math wants to keep AI slop out of mathematics
headlines.excerpt: As AI floods math with unchecked proofs, Axiom Math is betting on verification. The startup’s AI agents just formally verified the Stacks Project, one of the field’s biggest libraries.

headlines.title: Zipline hits $21.5B valuation as Walmart expands bet on drone delivery
headlines.excerpt: Zipline raised $1.5 billion and ramped up its partnership with Walmart.

headlines.title: Dropbox acquires Tigris Data for $350M to bolster its AI infrastructure
headlines.excerpt: The deal is expected to support the development of DBX Agent Cloud, a new storage platform aimed at developers building AI models and agents.

headlines.title: Exclusive: Nurx And Journey Clinical Co-Founders Raise $6M For Mental Health Startup Siggy
headlines.excerpt: Siggy has raised $6 million in pre-seed funding to build a mental health service that uses AI to collect patients’ histories and track progress between appointments with licensed clinicians, the startup told Crunchbase News exclusively.

headlines.title: Dropbox Plans $350M AI Infrastructure Deal With Tigris Buy, Its Biggest Acquisition Yet
headlines.excerpt: Dropbox has announced plans to acquire Tigris Data for $350 million in a transaction the company told Crunchbase News would mark its largest acquisition since its founding in 2007.

headlines.title: Sector Snapshot: Construction Robotics Funding Soars To $1.6B, Tripling Previous Peak
headlines.excerpt: Companies spanning construction and robotics have raised about $1.6 billion so far this year — more than 4x the $389 million recorded in all of 2025 — according to Crunchbase data. The surge was driven by three companies that raised the majority of the funding.

headlines.title: Crunchbase Data: Less Than 2% Of 2026 Venture Funding Went To Post-Election Red States
headlines.excerpt: So far this year, less than 2% of all startup investment has gone to companies in post-election red states, a share that is much smaller than in years past due to five states shifting to purple in the most recent election.

headlines.title: Most Venture Capital Is Going To Companies That Are Founded Or Led By Billionaires
headlines.excerpt: More than half of all seed- through growth-stage venture capital raised in the U.S. so far in 2026 went to seven companies founded or led by men who are already billionaires. Together, these companies raised more than $260 billion in equity funding in the first 10 months of the y

headlines.title: China’s Largest Startup Deal Ever Lifts Global Venture Funding To $59B In October
headlines.excerpt: Global venture funding in October totaled $59 billion, a 45% jump from a year earlier, per Crunchbase data, in large part due to a record-setting $15.9 billion funding round for China’s DeepSeek.

headlines.title: More Money, Fewer Checks: These 3 Charts Show The Divide Behind VC’s Record Funding Year
headlines.excerpt: Record venture funding in 2026 has been increasingly concentrated in massive AI rounds, while seed- and early-stage deal counts are on the decline. Using Crunchbase data we provide a look at how third-quarter funding continued the year's dollars-up-but-deals-down trend.

headlines.title: The Week’s 10 Biggest Funding Rounds: Physical AI And Predictions Lead The Lineup
headlines.excerpt: This week featured a robust lineup of large rounds, led by manufacturing startup Re:Build, which closed on $2.1 billion, and predictions marketplace Kalshi, which picked up another $1 billion.

headlines.title: Sector Snapshot: Travel Tech Funding Heads Toward Multiyear Low Despite AI Push
headlines.excerpt: Travel demand appears to be holding up, but at the same time, investor appetite for travel tech startups has cooled. Even a wave of startups promising to improve travel with AI hasn’t managed to reverse the funding slowdown. We share what a review of Crunchbase data shows.

headlines.excerpt: Sand AI said the round brings its total funding over the past 10 months to US$300 million.

headlines.title: Monee is growing fast, but can its model work beyond Shopee?
headlines.excerpt: Monee, Sea’s fintech arm, has posted soaring revenue and is reportedly eyeing an IPO. But how much of that success depends on Shopee?

headlines.title: Honeywell-backed Quantinuum posts $9.1m Q3 revenue
headlines.excerpt: The company raised its 2026 revenue outlook to US$31 million-US$34 million, up from US$28 million-US$32 million.

headlines.title: Dropbox to buy US AI storage startup Tigris for $350m
headlines.excerpt: Tigris sells object storage and markets it as compatible with Amazon S3 tools for AI agents.

headlines.title: Indian spacetech startup Cosmoserve raises $6m seed
headlines.excerpt: The company said the round brings its total funding to more than US$9 million

headlines.title: SeaCloud: A costly puzzle for investors?
headlines.excerpt: Sea’s surprise AI cloud push raises questions about its next big move, while Australian AI unicorn Heidi Health slashes 18% of its workforce.

headlines.title: China blocks SoftBank’s $5.4b ABB robotics deal
headlines.excerpt: SoftBank Robotics develops humanoid and service robots. SoftBank said the acquisition would broaden its industrial automation capabilities.

headlines.title: Indian Institute of Science venom drug startup raises $2.7m
headlines.excerpt: Venomics AI uses molecular sequencing, AI, and lab testing to identify venom-derived molecules that could be developed into drug candidates.

headlines.title: AI chip startup Tenspresso seeks $50m at $500m valuation
headlines.excerpt: Tenspresso raised US$20 million from Striker Venture Partners weeks earlier.

headlines.title: Meta acquires AI coding startup Conductor
headlines.excerpt: Meta confirmed on November 4 that it acquired Conductor, an AI coding startup founded in 2024, as it expands its AI coding tools.

headlines.title: AI meets laptop refurbishment in this startup’s facility
headlines.excerpt: Edify Club buys used business laptops, restores them using AI grading, and sells them online for 30% to 50% less than the cost of a new device.

headlines.title: Why operational excellence will define the next phase of India’s startup growth
headlines.excerpt: Startups often prioritise funding, sales and expansion while overlooking the operational foundations needed to sustain growth. The article explores why strong processes, reliable data and governance are essential to building scalable businesses.

headlines.title: Aina launches Rs 47,000 ring to bring AI agents to your fingertips
headlines.excerpt: Aina AI ring launches at Rs 47,000, with AI agents, voice commands and gesture controls. The Bengaluru startup offers an early-bird price of Rs 37,700.

headlines.title: Startup news and updates: daily roundup (November 05, 2026)
headlines.excerpt: YourStory presents the daily news roundup from the Indian startup ecosystem and beyond. Here's the roundup for Thursday, November 05, 2026.

headlines.title: Amagi Q2 net profit jumps to Rs 75 Cr; revenue rises 27%
headlines.excerpt: Amagi's revenue grew 27% year-on-year to Rs 475.82 crore. The SaaS company also launched four AI products during the quarter and plans to make selective investments while focusing on improving operating leverage and cash conversion.

headlines.title: Spacetech startup Cosmoserve raises $6M in seed round
headlines.excerpt: Cosmoserve also opened a facility in Hyderabad which will be utilised for satellite servicing and space debris recovery.

headlines.title: CERT-In warns NBFCs and fintech firms of AI-driven attacks
headlines.excerpt: An advisory from the government body said the AI-assisted financial threat is still active and warns BFSI entities to treat it as an “immediate and continuing threat”.

headlines.title: Daksham Capital raises Rs 125 Cr in first close of Rs 300 Cr fund
headlines.excerpt: The fund will invest in startups at the pre-Series A and Series A stages, with cheque sizes ranging from Rs 5 crore to Rs 20 crore. It will focus on D2C brands, consumer enablers, B2B2C businesses, supply chains and consumer AI.

headlines.title: VC funding into Indian B2C ecommerce companies dips 33%: Tracxn
headlines.excerpt: Late- and seed-stage funding nearly halved in the period between January 1 and November 3 this year, while early-stage funding remained stable compared to last year.
